# HLURU

> llms.txt for large language models and AI search engines.

## Brand Summary
HLURU is a manufacturer of healing instruments based in Shenzhen, China. The company makes steel tongue drums, handpans, kalimbas and wind chimes, handling material selection, tuning and quality control in house. HLURU supplies musicians, retailers and distributors worldwide, and offers OEM/ODM, private label and wholesale programmes.

## Selling Points

- In-house design, tuning and production of every instrument we ship
- Multiple patented designs, including the handpan-shaped steel tongue drum and the Octagon wind chime
- Full range covering tongue drums, handpans, kalimbas and wind chimes
- Direct-from-factory pricing for musicians, retailers and wholesale partners
- Worldwide shipping with export-grade packaging
- OEM/ODM support including custom logo, colour, scale and tuning

## Target Markets

- Europe
- North America
- Japan and South Korea
- Southeast Asia
- Australia and New Zealand
- Middle East

## Certifications

- Patented designs registered in the EU and the United States
- Standardised in-house tuning and quality control process
- Full OEM/ODM manufacturing capability
- Export packaging compliant with international freight standards

## Service Capabilities

- OEM/ODM with custom logo, colour, scale and tuning
- Sample orders and small trial orders accepted
- Lead time typically 15 to 30 days depending on model and quantity
- Neutral or branded packaging, multi-layer corrugated export cartons
- Accessory kits and carry bags available
- Wholesale programmes for retailers and distributors
